name: Design characters for specific video games and franchises
description: Users asked to design original units, NPCs, or combatants specifically tailored to fit the mechanics, lore, and existing entities of particular video games, anime, or comic book franchises. These requests often involved creating in-game assets like move lists, special abilities, or transformation states, as well as adapting standard character profiles to strict franchise constraints.
